description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a beloved Vancouver family business founded in 2006, growing from a single German bakery takeover in the Sunset neighbourhood to eight city-wide locations open every hour of every day of the year. Classic European recipes — including Bienenstich and artisan rye breads — sit alongside an expansive menu of pastries, donuts, sandwiches, cakes, soups, and specialty beverages, making it a well-rounded fuel stop for any appetite. The Davie Street location puts cyclists in the heart of central Vancouver with a wide selection of sweet and savoury options available at any hour.

The website's dedicated gluten-free and vegan menu sections directly support the OSM diet tags. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, device charging, or Wi-Fi details appear anywhere in the website content, so OSM's internet_access=wlan tag cannot be treated as authoritative per instructions; the OSM toilets:wheelchair=no tag implies on-site washrooms but is unconfirmed by the website.
